# `usaspending_transactions`

**USAspending award transactions**

Native transactions for one declared agency, fiscal year and award family, retaining exact obligations and original row coordinates.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Explicit selected full agency/year/family snapshots only. Local qualification and publication are separate. Never combine full snapshots or append an all-year delta. Contracts, funding rows, subawards and unselected agencies/years are outside the first qualified Denali FY2025 assistance cohort. See docs/usaspending-awards.md. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `usaspending_transactions.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `archive_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the retained original ZIP; join and filter on this snapshot identity before comparing revisions. |
| `archive_url` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher-advertised URL for the exact retained archive. A live URL alone does not establish unchanged bytes. |
| `archive_version` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher updated_date from the retained monthly inventory; separate from member spelling and capture time. |
| `award_family` | `VARCHAR` | Explicitly selected assistance or contracts; these families remain separate. |
| `fiscal_year` | `INTEGER` | Selected action-date fiscal year, beginning October 1 of the preceding calendar year. |
| `awarding_agency_code` | `VARCHAR` | Native Treasury agency code, checked on every transaction; differs from the inventory database ID. |
| `transaction_key` | `VARCHAR` | Native transaction unique key, unique within this selected archive. Duplicate revisions refuse. |
| `award_key` | `VARCHAR` | Native award unique key; one award can have several transactions. |
| `action_date` | `DATE` | Publisher action date, checked against the declared fiscal year. |
| `federal_action_obligation` | `DECIMAL(38,2)` | Exact signed federal obligation for this transaction, in USD. Add only within one selected snapshot. Negative adjustments remain negative. |
| `publisher_overall_award_obligated_amount` | `DECIMAL(38,2)` | Publisher overall-award obligation, in exact USD, spanning the award lifetime. Repeated on transaction rows; sum only once per archive and award in usaspending_awards. Blank is unknown. |
| `publisher_overall_award_outlayed_amount` | `DECIMAL(38,2)` | Publisher overall-award outlay, in exact USD, spanning the award lifetime. Repeated on transaction rows; sum only once per archive and award in usaspending_awards. It is not a fiscal-year or transaction outlay. Blank is unknown. |
| `recipient_uei` | `VARCHAR` | Literal recipient Unique Entity Identifier; blank remains blank. A join requires checking the other table scope and key uniqueness. |
| `recipient_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal recipient name at this transaction; names are not identity keys. |
| `recipient_state_code` | `VARCHAR` | Recipient location, separate from the place where the work occurs. |
| `place_of_performance_state_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal project/place-of-performance state; never substituted for recipient location. |
| `funding_agency_code` | `VARCHAR` | Native funding agency code, separate from awarding agency; no allocation of obligations across funding lists. |
| `award_type_code` | `VARCHAR` | Native assistance or contract type code, validated against the selected family. |
| `modification_number` | `VARCHAR` | Literal transaction modification number, preserving leading zeroes. |
| `last_modified_date` | `VARCHAR` | Literal publisher revision timestamp; never used to silently choose among duplicate keys. |
| `correction_delete_indicator_code` | `VARCHAR` | Literal correction/delete code. Deleted rows refuse financial use; no code is inferred for blanks. |
| `source_member` | `VARCHAR` | Exact original ZIP member name, independent of archive filename and updated_date. |
| `source_member_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the original decoded CSV member. |
| `record_number` | `BIGINT` | One-based data record number, excluding the CSV header. |
| `line_start` | `BIGINT` | One-based starting physical line in the original CSV, including its header. |
| `line_end` | `BIGINT` | One-based ending physical line; quoted multiline records can span several lines. |
| `raw_cells_json` | `VARCHAR` | All literal source cells keyed by native headers. Empty strings stay empty; unknown fields survive. An absent column remains absent. |
